title: Default finite oracle machine
statement: Define a finite oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with no ordinary work tapes and three states numbered $0,1,2$. Its initial state and positive-answer state are both $1$, its query state is $0$, and its negative-answer state is $2$. At every state and on every scanned input and work-tape symbol, its transition leaves the heads stationary, makes no writes or output, and halts; the query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states are pairwise distinct.
